evidence.ACL: There is a complete tear of mid fibers of anterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: The medial meniscus is intact. There is some non-surfacing peripheral signal seen within the posterior horn and posterior body at the meniscal capsular insertion site but there is no evidence of a definite meniscal tear or obvious meniscal capsular separation.
evidence.Lateral OA: The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.
evidence.PF OA: The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is reasonably well-maintained.
evidence.Effusion: There is a small knee effusion.
evidence.Baker's: There is no significant Baker's cyst.
